svg.title: Torchlight loop: Charcoal chiaroscuro
svg.desc: Torchlight loop (2D): seen from above at night, Tam walks the gravel road with one amber circle of torchlight; everything outside it is smudged charcoal dark. Inside the light, post 14 stands with its gravel apron and fire ring, ready to be ticked; just ahead, where post 13 stood, the light shows only forest floor and the road narrows. The tally strip on the right holds Tam's pencil ticks while the printed counter reads 13.
